name: KuCoin Account History (CSV)
description: KuCoin 'Account History' from the history export (kucoin.com: Account > Export History > Account History (Funding Account) / (Trading Account); CSV from the ZIP). Header UID, Account Type, Currency, Side, Amount, Fee, Time(UTC+08:00), Remark, Type. The time header names the export zone and is honoured. Amount is unsigned; Side (Deposit = in, Withdrawal = out) gives the direction; Fee is charged in the same currency. The Account Type (Funding/Main, Trading, …) becomes the account. The kind is read from Type and Remark with patterns, because KuCoin's wording varies. Known limits: import the FUNDING account file for deposits, withdrawals, transfers and Earn; the TRADING account file repeats every spot trade of the 'Spot Orders – Filled Orders' file, so do not import both (its trade rows also have no order id to pair them). Type/Remark wording is unconfirmed — check the preview for unknown values.
